policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O acquisition of Pierre Computer Company, Inc.
items.summary: O announced an acquisition of Pierre Computer Company to expand Codex’s tools for building, understanding, and reviewing code. Signals continued product expansion in developer tooling and code workflows.

items.headline: O honor robots.txt AI training preferences
items.summary: O said it will honor a shared robots.txt signal for participating providers, improving how websites communicate AI training preferences. Could reduce legal friction and increase publisher participation.

items.headline: O Model Spec update
items.summary: O updated its Model Spec to clarify behavior around five values, including faithfulness to human intent, harm minimization, and human agency/oversight guidance. Mostly governance/safety positioning rather than direct financial effects.

items.headline: O GPT-6.1 Terra rollout
items.summary: O launched GPT-6.1 Terra, including faster professional work and API pricing details ($1/M input, $0.05/M cached input, $5/M output). Supports visual reasoning, computer use, and writing, indicating capacity for enterprise workloads.

items.headline: G GroqCloud preview for Meta Muse Spark Open
items.summary: G announced a limited preview availability of Meta’s Muse Spark Open on GroqCloud, highlighting strong inference throughput (e.g., claimed tokens/sec per user) and long-context support (context window specified). Signals ongoing demand and partner ecosystem momentum.

items.headline: V hiring + W-Series expansion outlook
items.summary: Space.com reported V’s September Series D ($251M) and plans to hire 100 people by end of 2027, alongside its W-Series manufacturing cadence. Suggests scaling capacity and operational runway, supporting growth assumptions.

items.headline: V W-6 mission page updated
items.summary: V’s mission page for W-6 references payload/materials and includes an AFRL public affairs approval code, indicating continued government-facing mission activity. Mostly operational transparency; limited direct financial/valuation signal.
